series.name: UT1500EG / UT1500EIG / UT2200EG / UT2200EIG (line-interactive 1500-2200VA, 230V, Green/Yellow/Red LED)
series.notes: This family has NO numeric fault codes at all. Diagnosis is entirely by counting the flashes of the RED Fault LED: once/5s, twice/5s, 3x/5s, 4x/5s, plus an overload-warning row. Entries are therefore recorded as LED-pattern codes. The same family also documents a blown fuse / tripped breaker in the troubleshooting table. Verified against two independent hosting copies of the identical CyberPower manual (K01-C000756-01).

codes.code: Red LED: ON, Flash once every 5 seconds
aliases: Red LED: ON, Flash once every 5 seconds

title.en: Red LED 1 flash / 5s - Battery Output Short
title.ur: Red LED 1 blink / 5s - Battery Output Short (battery se chalte waqt output short)

meaning.en: The UPS output is shorted while on battery. Continuous tone, and the red LED blinks once every five seconds.
meaning.ur: Battery par chalte waqt UPS output short ho gaya hai. Mukhtalif tone, aur red LED paanch second mein ek baar blink karta hai.

causes.en: A connected appliance has failed short-circuiting.
causes.ur: Koi connected appliance short ho kar kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: A multi-way power strip or extension lead has crushed or cut a live core.
causes.ur: Kisi multi-way power strip ya extension lead ka koi live core kata ya daba hua hai.

causes.en: Outlet terminals on the UPS are loose/bridged, or a cable has been pinched behind the unit.
causes.ur: UPS ke outlet terminals dheele ya bridge hue hain, ya unit ke peeche koi cable pinch ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: As the manual directs, turn off the UPS and unplug at least one piece of equipment.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai, UPS off karein aur kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein.

solutions.en: For safe inspection, unplug the mains cord as well, then confirm the overload breaker/fuse is intact and reset it.
solutions.ur: Safe check ke liye mains cord bhi nikaal dein, phir confirm karein ke overload breaker/fuse salamat hai aur use reset karein.

solutions.en: With the unit isolated, test each outlet to neutral on a multimeter in continuity/ohms; near-zero ohms pinpoints the shorted socket.
solutions.ur: Unit isolate karne ke baad multimeter continuity/ohms par har outlet ko neutral se test karein; zero ke qareeb ohms shorted socket ki taraf ishara karta hai.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one at a time; the device that makes the LED return to 1-flash mode is the faulty short - remove and repair it.
solutions.ur: Loads ek-ek karke wapas lagayein; jis device par LED wapas 1-flash mode mein aaye wohi faulty short hai - use nikaal kar repair karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, ON then 1 flash every 5 seconds, constant tone

codes.code: Red LED: ON, Flash twice every 5 seconds
aliases: Red LED: ON, Flash twice every 5 seconds

title.ur: Red LED 2 blink / 5s - Overload Fault (load rating se zyada)

meaning.en: Connected equipment exceeds the rating of the unit. This is a latched overload fault, distinct from the 1-flash short fault.
meaning.ur: Connected equipment unit ki rating se zyada hai. Yeh latched overload fault hai, 1-flash short fault se alag.

causes.en: Total connected wattage/VA exceeds the 1500/2200VA rating of the unit.
causes.ur: Total connected wattage/VA unit ki 1500/2200VA rating se zyada hai.

causes.en: A high inrush device (compressor, laser printer, motor) tripped the overload.
causes.ur: Koi high inrush device (compressor, laser printer, motor) ne overload kar diya.

causes.en: The rear overload breaker has tripped and stays out until reset.
causes.ur: Peeche ka overload breaker trip ho gaya hai aur reset tak bahar hi rehta hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off and unplug at least one piece of equipment, as the manual states.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai, UPS off karein aur kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein.

solutions.en: If an overload is detected the unit emits one long beep: wait 10 seconds, make sure the breaker/fuse is normal, then turn the UPS on.
solutions.ur: Overload detect hone par unit aik lamba beep deta hai: 10 second intezaar karein, breaker/fuse normal check karein, phir UPS on karein.

solutions.en: Total the connected load on a power meter and keep it inside the unit's rating (e.g. 900W on UT1500EG, 1320W on UT2200EG).
solutions.ur: Connected load power meter par total karein aur use unit ki rating ke andar rakhein (UT1500EG 900W, UT2200EG 1320W).

solutions.en: If the overload clears with one device removed but that device must stay, replace it with a lower-surge or staggered-start unit.
solutions.ur: Agar ek device nikalne par overload clear ho jaye lekin woh device rakhna bhi ho, to us ki jagah kam surge ya staggered-start wala unit lagayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, ON then 2 flashes every 5 seconds, constant tone

codes.code: Red LED: ON, Flash 3 times every 5 seconds
aliases: Red LED: ON, Flash 3 times every 5 seconds

title.ur: Red LED 3 blink / 5s - Charger Fault (charger kharab, battery charge nahi hoti)

meaning.en: The internal battery charger has failed. Manual remedy is to contact CyberPower for support.
meaning.ur: Internal battery charger kharab ho gaya hai. Manual ke mutabiq CyberPower se support lein.

causes.en: Charger IC/MOSFET or charge-sense circuit on the main board has failed.
causes.ur: Main board par charger IC/MOSFET ya charge-sense circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery bank dead, deep-discharged or wrong type, pulling the charger into a fault state.
causes.ur: Battery bank dead, gehri tarah discharged ya galat type, charger ko fault state mein kheench raha hai.

causes.en: Overheating from a blocked vent or failed fan has destroyed the charger section.
causes.ur: Blocked vent ya kharab fan se overheating ne charger section tabah kar diya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate first: turn the UPS off, unplug the mains cord, and disconnect the battery quick-connects (positive and negative).
solutions.ur: Pehle isolate karein: UPS off karein, mains cord nikaal dein, aur battery quick-connects (positive aur negative) disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery on DC volts; a healthy 12V cell reads 12.6-13.0V at rest, and near 0V means the pack must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Har battery DC volt par measure karein; healthy 12V cell aaram ke waqt 12.6-13.0V deta hai, aur 0V ke qareeb ho to pack badalna hai.

solutions.en: With mains reconnected, read charge voltage at the battery terminals: 13.5-14V means healthy, near 0V means the charger output has failed.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas lagane ke baad battery terminals par charge voltage dekhein: 13.5-14V healthy, 0V ke qareeb charger output kharab.

solutions.en: Contact CyberPower for support as the manual directs - there is no user-replaceable charger part.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai CyberPower se support lein - charger ka koi user-replaceable part nahi hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, ON then 3 flashes every 5 seconds, constant tone

codes.code: Red LED: ON, Flash 4 times every 5 seconds
aliases: Red LED: ON, Flash 4 times every 5 seconds

title.ur: Red LED 4 blink / 5s - Hardware Fault (unit ka andar ka hissa kharab)

meaning.en: An internal hardware fault in the unit. Manual remedy is to contact CyberPower for support.
meaning.ur: Unit ke andar ka internal hardware fault. Manual ke mutabiq CyberPower se support lein.

causes.en: Failed relay, SCR or inverter MOSFET in the power path.
causes.ur: Power path mein relay, SCR ya inverter MOSFET kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Control board failure or loss of calibration.
causes.ur: Control board ki khami ya calibration kho jana.

causes.en: Cracked internal solder joint, or a component failed from internal overheating.
causes.ur: Internal solder joint crack, ya koi component internal overheating se kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Do a full isolation and discharge: off, unplug mains, disconnect the batteries, and leave the unit a few minutes.
solutions.ur: Poora isolation aur discharge karein: off, mains nikaal dein, batteries disconnect karein, aur unit ko kuch minute chhor dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect and try one clean power cycle; if the 4-flash pattern clears, record the event and watch the unit for recurrence.
solutions.ur: Wapas connect kar ke aik saaf power cycle karein; agar 4-flash pattern clear ho jaye to event note karein aur wapas aane par nazar rakhein.

solutions.en: If the 4-flash pattern returns with the battery disconnected, the fault is in the control/inverter board, not the battery or the load.
solutions.ur: Agar battery disconnect kar ke bhi 4-flash pattern aaye to fault control/inverter board mein hai, battery ya load mein nahi.

solutions.en: Contact CyberPower for support as the manual directs - this is a service-level repair only.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai CyberPower se support lein - yeh sirf service level repair hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, ON then 4 flashes every 5 seconds, constant tone

title.ur: Red LED baari baar blink - Overload Warning (load pehle se zyada hai)

meaning.en: The load already exceeds the unit rating, so the unit is warning about overload before it becomes a latched fault. Not yet a shutdown fault.
meaning.ur: Load pehle se unit ki rating se zyada hai, is liye unit latched fault banne se pehle overload ki warning de raha hai. Abhi shutdown fault nahi.

causes.en: Connected equipment exceeds the rating of the unit but has not yet tripped the latched overload.
causes.ur: Connected equipment unit ki rating se zyada hai magar abhi latched overload trigger nahi hua.

causes.en: A device with a large inrush has just been switched on alongside the existing load.
causes.ur: Bade inrush wala device abhi mojood load ke saath on kiya gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off and unplug at least one piece of equipment from the battery power supplied outlets.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein aur battery power supplied outlets se kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Wait 10 seconds before restarting, then confirm the circuit breaker / fuse is in its normal position.
solutions.ur: Restart se pehle 10 second intezaar karein, phir confirm karein ke circuit breaker / fuse apni normal position mein hai.

solutions.en: Verify the remaining load with a power meter and keep it under the unit's rated watts/VA.
solutions.ur: Power meter se bacha hua load verify karein aur use unit ki rated watts/VA se kam rakhein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, continuous flashing, constant tone

title.ur: Yellow LED blink kar raha - Low Battery (battery khatam hone wali hai)

meaning.en: The UPS is on battery and the battery is about to run out. Save work now; the unit will shut down shortly.
meaning.ur: UPS battery par hai aur battery khatam hone wali hai. Abhi kaam save karein; unit jald band ho jayega.

causes.en: The mains outage has lasted long enough to drain the battery bank.
causes.ur: Mains outage itni der raha ke battery bank khaali ho gaya.

causes.en: The battery bank is worn out and no longer holds a usable charge.
causes.ur: Battery bank purani ho chuki hai aur ab usable charge nahi rakhti.

solutions.en: Shut down connected equipment immediately to preserve the remaining charge for the load.
solutions.ur: Baaki charge load ke liye bacha kar rakhne ke liye connected equipment foran band karein.

solutions.en: After mains returns, leave the UPS plugged in for at least 4 hours (the manual's guidance for a discharged battery) and prefer a full 8-hour recharge.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane ke baad UPS ko kam az kam 4 ghante plug mein rakhein (discharged battery ke liye manual ka hidayat) aur behtar 8 ghante poori recharge karein.

solutions.en: If low battery comes back after a full recharge on every outage, measure the pack on DC volts and plan a battery replacement.
solutions.ur: Agar har outage par poori recharge ke baad bhi low battery aaye to pack DC volt par measure karein aur battery badalne ka mansooba banayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow battery LED flashing, rapid beeping

title.en: Green LED steady on - ECO Mode (normal)
title.ur: Green LED steady on - ECO Mode (mains normal, sab theek)

meaning.en: Utility is normal and the UPS is in energy-saving bypass mode. This is the healthy idle state.
meaning.ur: Mains normal hai aur UPS energy-saving bypass mode mein hai. Yeh healthy idle state hai.

causes.en: Utility supply is within range and the load is below the energy-saving threshold.
causes.ur: Mains range ke andar hai aur load energy-saving threshold se kam hai.

solutions.en: No action needed; this mode reduces standby power and helps battery life.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaruri nahi; yeh mode standby power kam karta hai aur battery ki umar barhata hai.

solutions.en: If you need assured backup, raise the load above the ECO threshold or change the mode as described in the unit's setup instructions.
solutions.ur: Agar pakka backup chahiye to load ko ECO threshold se upar lein ya unit ke setup instructions ke mutabiq mode badal dein.

codes.blinkPattern: Green utility LED steady on, no alarm

title.ur: Green LED dheere dheere blink - Charging (battery charge ho rahi hai)

meaning.en: Utility is normal and the UPS is charging the battery. Normal, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Mains normal hai aur UPS battery charge kar raha hai. Normal hai, fault nahi.

causes.en: The battery is recharging after a discharge, or the pack has just been replaced.
causes.ur: Battery discharge ke baad recharge ho rahi hai, ya pack abhi abhi badli gayi hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature is low, which slows the charge rate.
causes.ur: Mauhal ka temperature kam hai, jis se charge rate slow ho jata hai.

solutions.en: No action needed - keep the unit plugged in; the manual specifies about 8 hours typical recharge.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaruri nahi - unit plug mein rakhein; manual ke mutabiq aam tor par 8 ghante recharge hota hai.

solutions.en: If the LED never stops slow-flashing after 10+ hours, measure the charger output at the battery terminals on DC volts (expect 13.5-14V).
solutions.ur: Agar 10+ ghante baad bhi LED slow-flash karta rahe to charger output battery terminals par DC volt par measure karein (13.5-14V expect karein).

codes.blinkPattern: Green utility LED slow-flashing, no alarm

aliases: Outlets do not provide power to equipment

title.en: No output at outlets - fuse blown or breaker tripped
title.ur: Outlets par output nahi - fuse ula ya breaker trip

meaning.en: The outlets supply nothing because the overload protection fuse has blown or the circuit-breaker knob has tripped.
meaning.ur: Outlets kuch nahi de rahe kyunke overload protection fuse ula hua hai ya circuit-breaker knob trip ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Fuse is blown or the breaker has tripped due to an overload.
causes.ur: Fuse ula hua hai ya overload ki wajah se breaker trip hua hai.

causes.en: Batteries are discharged so the UPS has nothing to pass on in battery mode.
causes.ur: Batteries discharged hain is liye battery mode mein UPS ke paas dene ko kuch nahi hai.

causes.en: The unit has been damaged by a surge or spike.
causes.ur: Surge ya spike se unit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off and unplug at least one piece of connected equipment, then unplug the UPS power cord.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein aur kam az kam ek connected equipment nikaal dein, phir UPS ka power cord nikaal dein.

solutions.en: With the cord out, replace the blown fuse with a spare overload one of the same specification, or press the circuit breaker knob.
solutions.ur: Cord nikaal kar, ula hua fuse usi specification ke spare overload fuse se badal dein, ya circuit breaker knob daba dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect the power cord, turn the UPS on, and make sure the spare fuse meets the specified rating.
solutions.ur: Power cord wapas lagayein, UPS on karein, aur confirm karein ke spare fuse specified rating ke mutabiq hai.

solutions.en: If the batteries are simply discharged, allow the unit to recharge for at least 4 hours before expecting output; if a surge damaged the unit, contact CyberPower technical support.
solutions.ur: Agar batteries sirf discharged hain to output ki umeed karne se pehle unit ko kam az kam 4 ghante recharge dein; agar surge se unit kharab hua hai to CyberPower technical support se rabta karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Green LED steady (or off) with no output at any outlet
